terminals.description: Jack's Mesh Command dashboard server (bts_serve.py) on http://127.0.0.1:8765/jack_command.html. Serves the static dashboard plus the /api/state, /api/burn, /api/surfaces, /api/policy, /api/capacity and /api/bench routes. Binds 127.0.0.1 only, by design.
